verdicts.reason: Both are the same broken strip. Text is crammed at sizes too small to read: the event details, the italic tagline and the URL are illegible at this height. The RSVP CTA has shrunk to a pill the same size as the info tags and no longer stands out. The 'missing asset' placeholder collides with the right-hand venue text. The brand cluster on the left is jammed against the top edge and the can is crushed beside it. B is slightly worse because it leaves 'Pier 9' broken onto an orphan line with a gap under the URL, and its can sits lower and more cramped against the bottom edge.
